title: "Ensemble Methods"

## Readings

*An Introduction to Statistical Learning* chapter 8.2.

*Hands-on Machine Learning with R* has some nice chapters on [bagging](https://bradleyboehmke.github.io/HOML/bagging.html), [random forests](https://bradleyboehmke.github.io/HOML/random-forest.html), and [boosting](https://bradleyboehmke.github.io/HOML/gbm.html).

## Assignments

Download the Rmarkdown file and open it in RStudio. The first part will walk through and explain implementing the key concepts for this week. Complete the questions in the *on your own* section at the end. Submit your PDF to Brightspace.

* Bagging and Random Forests Lab ([PDF](/assignments/bagging_and_random_forests/bagging_and_random_forests.pdf), [Rmarkdown](/assignments/bagging_and_random_forests/bagging_and_random_forests.Rmd))
